title: TWIST: A Proposed Benchmark for Intervention Quality in Conversational Memory, with a Human-Validated Draft-Alignment

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.28575）：TWIST 提出 conversational memory 评测里尚未被测过的'intervention quality'维度——把 memory 系统作为'self-contained ingest/recall/vet surface'在 belief change points 上做正确性评估，覆盖 4 tracks：unprompted tension detection / vetting outgoing drafts against the record / answering with current state / over-update resistance；并提供 human-validated draft-alignment。这是 context-engineering × llm-evaluation × rag-knowledge 的'评测空白填补'方法学资产：现有 memory benchmark 多测 recall / prompted updates，TWIST 补的是'系统作为整体在干预点是否正确'——这与团队'agent 在关键决策点是否能拒绝 / 修订自己输出'的能力直接相关。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 4 tracks 协议、human-validated 数据规模、scoring 是否公开。今日动作：即时试点方向，写'memory intervention quality'checklist 草稿，关注与 28075 'Reliability Routing'、28570 DEEPO 形成'今日评测 × agent 可靠性三联证据'。
